title: TripAdvisor Reviews Scraper
description: Extract hotel user reviews from a TripAdvisor hotel page URL using API pagination.

startUrl.title: TripAdvisor hotel URL (optional)
startUrl.description: Hotel review page URL. If empty, the actor falls back to INPUT.json value. The scraper automatically extracts locationId from the URL.

results_wanted.title: Maximum number of reviews
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of reviews to collect.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxy is recommended for stable extraction.
